_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
I Klondike Solitaire khelh i ni. I tum ber chu card zawng zawng foundation piles-ah sawn tur a ni.

Game Dan:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Ace atanga King thleng suit anga siam
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Dang sei zawngin color inang lo (sen hmangah dum, dum hmangah sen)
- Stock: Waste pile-ah card lak
- Waste (W): Card hawn chung ber khel theih

Hriattirna:
- 'draw' - Stock atanga waste-ah card lak
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Piles karah card sawn
  Entirna: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count 'all'-ah pawh dah theih, card hawn zawng zawng sawn tum ang.
- 'forfeit' - Game titawp nghal leh score tunlai hmuh theih
- Pile hming: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Thiltih tam tak khatah action pahnih aia tam theih, comma hmangin then darh:
  Entirna: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Tableau piles awm loha King chiah dah theih.
Action-te hmaih kaia theih, pakhat a hlawhchham chuan a dangte thulh leh a ni.
Game khelh theih tawh lo tia i ring chuan 'forfeit' hmang rawh.
